result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position: Corio may terminate on 30 days’ written notice, receives a refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, and Commerce One has no convenience-termination right during a committed term. However, adding a right to terminate “in whole or in part” exceeds the playbook requirement and may alter committed scope. It also creates ambiguity because the refund language does not specify that, for a partial termination, the refund is limited to fees attributable to the terminated portion. Deleting “in whole or in part,” or adding a clear partial-termination allocation mechanism, would make the revision more targeted and precise.
